response.overview: Three outspoken atheists Daksh, Abhay and Reeti accept an invitation to attend an unusual gathering at a remote farmhouse. What begins as an evening of conversation and intellectual provocation gradually turns into something far more unsettling.  As their hosts introduce ideas that challenge everything the three believe about faith, consciousness and reality, the boundaries between philosophy and experience begin to collapse. Each guest is forced to confront something deeply personal and increasingly impossible to explain.  By the end of the night, their certainty about the world, and their place within it, may no longer survive.
response.title: Nohum
